day_shape: 63 items: Houthi missile on Riyadh airport kills 12 (US national among dead), CENTCOM disables tanker running Iran blockade in Gulf of Oman, UKMTO reports Strait of Hormuz tanker strike, Trump floats joining Houthi/Iran strikes, heavy Khamenei/IRIB Police Week cycle, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported at least 12 killed and over 300 wounded in a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh's main airport, with a US national among the dead and a second ballistic missile intercepted. Mecca Joint Defense Agreement members condemned the attack; Defa Press carried Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree vowing to continue an 'airport for airport' equation.

threads.label: US naval blockade and Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced a US fighter jet disabled the Panama-flagged M/V Ocean Molica in the Gulf of Oman after it attempted to run the naval blockade on Iran, while UKMTO reported a tanker struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz and the IRGC said another tanker exploded after hitting a naval mine. Kpler's crude analysis head said Iran's oil export revenue could dry up entirely by mid-December if the blockade holds.

threads.label: US weighing fresh Iran and Houthi strikes
threads.summary: Iran International reported Trump raised the possibility of joining strikes on the Houthis and resuming attacks on Iran following the Riyadh airport attack, while Maariv sources said Washington pressed Israel over the past fortnight to carry out a solo Iran strike. Separately, Channel 12's Barak Ravid cited two US and one Israeli official saying the US did not ask Israel to strike Iran before elections, and a CRS report detailed 81 US aircraft damaged or destroyed in the Iran war.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and missile reconstitution
threads.summary: A Washington-based research institute cited by Iran International said new construction at an Iranian compound previously struck by Israel suggests Tehran may be restoring operations at a site linked to nuclear weapons research. Unnamed Western officials told Bloomberg Iran has preserved its missile and drone factories and can replenish stocks with Russian help; Iran International also reported an internal Tehran debate on abandoning nuclear ambiguity, while Foreign Minister Araghchi called attacks on nuclear facilities an 'unforgivable crime'.

threads.label: Gaza ceasefire strains and IDF strikes
threads.summary: The IDF said it eliminated Islamic Jihad company commander Muhammad Abu Shalouf and Nukhba terrorist Musa Abu Dan, as well as Islamic Jihad anti-tank commander Muhammad Walid Saadi Nakhala, citing systematic ceasefire violations. Jerusalem Post reported Hamas showing signs of preparing attacks on Israeli forces, an IDF interceptor fired at a target over southern Lebanon, and former Biden aide Phil Gordon claiming Netanyahu delayed a hostage deal by six months in 2024.

threads.label: Iran leadership defiance messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press carried Deputy Army Coordinator Admiral Siahri saying Iran would target enemy vessels if attacked again, and President Pezeshkian saying no power can subdue a united Iranian nation. Khamenei's office issued a Police Week message praising the FARAJA commander, while Defa Press reported three Jundallah members arrested with a weapons cache in Chabahar.

threads.label: Minab school attack commemorations
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried heavy coverage of the Minab school attack, including the unveiling of a book 'Blood of Minab', government spokesman Mohajerani calling for art and literature to narrate the tragedy, and the Deputy Foreign Minister saying cases are being compiled in foreign courts. The Islamic Revolution Housing Foundation said repairs to over 102,000 war-damaged units across 24 provinces will be completed by end of Aban.
